title: APHN Submits Joint Representation on Swasthya Sathi Reimbursement Structures
summary: The delegation representing APHN met with health department officials to request smoother processing workflows and dialogue channels.
content: In a bid to address delayed processing cycles and support operational stability, APHN delegation members met with the Health & Family Welfare Department of West Bengal. The representation discussed improvements for Swasthya Sathi pre-authorizations and suggested structured timelines for clinical reimbursements. The department was receptive and suggested regular coordination channels.

title: Workshop Hosted in Hooghly for Clinical Establishment Compliance
summary: APHN training wing organized a compliance roadmap session for clinical establishment licensing renewals.
content: Over 45 nursing home owners and clinicians attended the licensing support camp organized in Chinsurah, Hooghly. Led by legal cell coordinators, the workshop explained online license applications, fire safety declarations, bio-medical waste compliance, and mandatory reporting protocols under the Clinical Establishments Act.

title: State Paramedic Skill Training Program Launched in Kolkata
summary: APHN launches skill development modules for nursing and supportive paramedical staff across private clinics.
content: The APHN Training and Quality Assurance Committee launched the state-wide Paramedic Skill Training Initiative. The first batch, trained at Kolkata Multispecialty Hospital, focused on critical care diagnostics, patient transfer dignity protocols, emergency response management, and primary nursing standards.

title: State-wide Campaign Commenced on Patient Safety and Dignity
summary: APHN announces patient-centric directives for members, reinforcing ethical practices and transparency in billing.
content: The Patient Safety Council of APHN officially rolled out the Patient Dignity Charter. The guidelines instruct member nursing homes to establish visible billing displays, outline grievance reporting structures, and ensure clear channels of communication during patient discharge workflows, promoting trust between doctors and patients.
